meta.title: my-calendar
meta.description: A personal calendar to manage events monthly, chat with AI about them, and get reminders

home.calendarPlaceholder: The monthly calendar will appear here.

login.signInDescription: Enter your details to check your schedule
login.signUpDescription: Get started with your email and a password
login.guestHint: Try it without signing up. Your events are kept in this browser and deleted after 30 days without a visit.

nav.guestSignOutDescription: If you sign out, the events and AI chats you made as a guest are deleted right away and can't be recovered.

eventForm.dragHint: Drag the block on the grid to change the day and time, and drag its top or bottom edge to change the length.
eventForm.moveFailed: Couldn't move the event. It was put back where it was.
eventForm.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete the event. It was restored.

ai.title: AI chat
ai.emptyHint: e.g. What's on this week? / Add a dentist visit tomorrow at 3pm
ai.deleteAllConfirm: Delete all saved AI chats? This cannot be undone.

notices.cut: The answer was long and got cut off.

ai.disclaimer: AI answers can be wrong. Events are only saved when you press Add on the card. Depending on your question, event titles and descriptions are sent to Google Gemini, and chats are stored for 30 days after the last message.
